mapper.sql: select v.visitor_id, v.token_hash, v.channel_code, v.content_code, v.client_platform, cast(v.profile as text) as profile, v.app_user_id, v.merged_into, v.last_seen_time, v.del_flag, v.create_by, v.create_time, v.update_by, v.update_time, v.remark from abr_visitor v
mapper.insert: insert into abr_visitor (token_hash, channel_code, content_code, client_platform, profile, last_seen_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{tokenHash}, coalesce(#{channelCode}, 'direct'), coalesce(#{contentCode}, ''), coalesce(#{clientPlatform}, ''), '{}'::jsonb, now(), '0', '', now())
mapper.update: update abr_visitor set last_seen_time = now() where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and (last_seen_time is null or last_seen_time < now() - interval '10 minutes')
update abr_visitor set profile = coalesce(profile, '{}'::jsonb) || cast(#{patch} as jsonb), update_time = now() where visitor_id = #{visitorId}
update abr_visitor set profile = '{}'::jsonb, update_time = now() where visitor_id = #{visitorId}
update abr_visitor set app_user_id = #{appUserId}, update_time = now() where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and app_user_id is null

update abr_visitor t set profile = coalesce(t.profile, '{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(f.profile, '{}'::jsonb), update_time = now() from abr_visitor f where t.visitor_id = #{toId} and f.visitor_id = #{fromId}
update abr_visitor set merged_into = #{toId}, app_user_id = #{appUserId}, update_time = now() where visitor_id = #{fromId}
update abr_profile set visitor_id = #{toId} where visitor_id = #{fromId}
update abr_assessment_file set visitor_id = #{toId} where visitor_id = #{fromId}
update abr_tool_run set visitor_id = #{toId} where visitor_id = #{fromId}

update abr_plan_material t set done = true, done_time = coalesce(t.done_time, f.done_time), app_user_id = #{appUserId}, update_time = now() from abr_plan_material f where t.visitor_id = #{toId} and f.visitor_id = #{fromId} and t.material_key = f.material_key and f.done and not t.done
mapper.insert: insert into abr_plan_active (visitor_id, active_date, item_count, open_count, first_time, last_time) select #{toId}, f.active_date, f.item_count, f.open_count, f.first_time, f.last_time from abr_plan_active f where f.visitor_id = #{fromId} on conflict (visitor_id, active_date) do update set item_count = greatest(abr_plan_active.item_count, excluded.item_count), open_count = abr_plan_active.open_count + excluded.open_count, first_time = least(abr_plan_active.first_time, excluded.first_time), last_time = greatest(abr_plan_active.last_time, excluded.last_time)
mapper.update: update abr_share set revoked = true, update_time = now() where visitor_id = #{fromId} and not revoked

with p as (update abr_plan_item set app_user_id = #{appUserId} where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and app_user_id is null returning 1), m as (update abr_plan_material set app_user_id = #{appUserId} where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and app_user_id is null returning 1) update abr_event set app_user_id = #{appUserId} where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and app_user_id is null
